record.title: Korala pandemic-era access restriction and local-passholder restoration in November 2023
record.scope: Korala crossing for eligible residents of two border municipalities
record.movement: Residents of Lo Manthang and Lo-Ghekar Damodar Kunda holding border-area passes
record.exceptions: Other cohorts or traffic are not established as restricted; see current phase qualification.
record.imposing_authority: Chinese border authorities and Nepal local administration
record.enforcement: Source-specific reported interruption and scoped restoration; see Chronology phases.
record.relationship: No matching Korala parent was found in the baseline index. This record describes the separately observed November 2023 local-passholder restoration. Korala was described within a fourteen-point reopening programme; membership in the seven immediate May 2024 gates is unresolved because the ministry extract names districts rather than every gate. Retain the relationship with REC50-R02-002 and do not count the records as independent border closures.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no inference of current border status.
record.current_timing: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: Korala’s November 13, 2023 inauguration is separate from evidence that residents with passes had begun visiting China by the November 14 report. The actual local-passholder endpoint is bounded November 13–14. Ordinary tourists and unrestricted freight are not established as reopened. Conflicting coarse onset accounts and pre-existing twice-yearly trading arrangements prevent a continuous four-year operational duration. Related network/crossing records may overlap; they are not counts of independent closure events. See the Dimensions relationship field.

followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: Korala’s pandemic-related local access restriction and scoped restoration are supported. Retain the parent linked to the broader programme instead of counting an additional independent countrywide closure. The observed cohort is passholding residents of Lo Manthang and Lo-Ghekar Damodar Kunda travelling into China. Other tourists, unrestricted freight and all residents of Nepal are not established as reopened. The 13 November 2023 inauguration is separate from confirmation by the 14 November account that residents had begun crossing. Retain the 13–14 November endpoint bound, unknown precise onset and seasonal/intermittent qualification. Coarse 2019/2076 BS/2020 accounts do not become exact dates. Local and press accounts attribute the interruption to COVID. The initial order remains unavailable, and normal twice-yearly trade-fair gaps are not coded as pandemic closure-days. Nepal Press now returns 403, so add the freshly read Annapurna Express account as a matching republished alternate path. Advance reports and the 2024 programme article were read; the original ministry PDF timed out. Programme gate membership remains unresolved. This reviewer authored R02, which is explicitly disclosed. The accepted phase is unlocated pending B01. The two-municipality cohort and crossing name do not justify a country outline or a generic all-traffic marker.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 75f71973a192fafd898d69eee3f642a94b186f28c8ab91f32c95fb2d2560df1a. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the full fixed sample audit of 16 parents and 27 phases, including 29 guarded input-cell corrections and the new Sadao onset question. Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R05-NQ03 — Keep REC50-R02-005-U01 open. The original order, exact onset, first traveller timestamp and immediate May 2024 gate membership remain unresolved; the alternate source does not resolve them.
